_note: PLACEHOLDER measurements. Replace with the real rig. Units: mm and degrees. Table frame: origin at the front-left corner of the table top's footprint, x along the width (to the right), y along the depth (away from the front edge), z up from the floor. Angles are counter-clockwise seen from above, 0 = +x.

table._goal_edge_values: front (y = 0) | back (y = depth) | left (x = 0) | right (x = width)

arm._angles: arm.angle is the servo angle. Heading of the stick in the table frame = heading_at_zero + direction * angle. height is the stick's height above the table top.
